test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Residents of the area are still trying to come to terms with the ______ of the disaster.
solution: The correct answer is "enormity." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"enormity" **means the very great size, effect, etc. of something; the fact that something is very serious. (किसी वस्‍तु की विशालता; प्रभाव की गंभीरता; अति गंभीरता की स्थिति) • **Example**:* I don't think you realize the **enormity**__ of the problem.* • The area's residents are still unable to comprehend the scope of the catastrophe. • The correct answer is Option 4. **Correct sentence**: *Residents of the area are still trying to come to terms with the __**enormity**__ of the disaster. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Heinousness: **the quality of being shockingly cruel and inhumane. (अत्यंत क्रूर और अमानवीय होने का गुण) • **Duress: **threats or force that are used to make somebody do something. (धमकी या दबाव (कुछ करवाने या मनवाने के लिए)) • **Atrocity: **(an act of) very cruel treatment of somebody/something. (अति क्रूर व्‍यवहार, अत्‍याचार, पाशविक कृत्‍य) 39:Tdce, The correct answer is “**Obstruct**”.
